senses.gloss: fit, esp. kasher, ritually permitted, legal, opp. פסול, טרפה. Fem. כְּשֵׁרָה, כְּשֵׁירָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:4">Ḥull. I, 4</cite> <he>כ׳ בשחיטה פסול במליקה</he> what is legal in slaughtering (cutting the throat) is illegal in pinching (the neck).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>שְׁחִיטָתוֹ כ׳</he> his act of slaughtering has been properly executed.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:6">Kidd. IV, 6</cite> <he>בתו כ׳ לכהונה</he> his daughter is fit to marry a priest.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:4">Gitt. IX, 4</cite> <he>הולד כ׳</he> the issue is legitimate, is under no religious or civil disabilities; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּשֵׁרִים</he>, <he>כְּשֵׁרִין</he>, <he>כְּשֵׁי׳</he>; f. <cite ref="K01329"><he>כְּשֵׁרוֹת</he></cite>, <he>כְּשֵׁי׳</he>.
Ḥull. III, 2 אלו כ׳ בבהמה the following defects in a domestic animal are kasher, i.e. do not make the animals unfit for eating.
Ib. 3 אם אדומים כ׳ if they (the entrails) are red (have their natural color) they are (the animal is) kasher; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:7">Ber. II, 7</cite> <he>כ׳ היה</he> he was a worthy man.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Kidd. IV, 14</cite> <he>הכ׳ שבטבחים</he> the best of butchers; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Ib.</cite> <he>רובן כ׳</he> are mostly honest men, opp. <he>רשעים</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:9:6">Y. Yoma III, end, 41ᵇ</cite> <he>כְּשַׁירֵי כל דור ודור</he> the worthiest of every generation; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:5">Y. Shek. V, beg. 48ᶜ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:5:3">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 6:6">Dem. VI, 6</cite> <he>צנועי בית הלל</he>) <he>מהו צנועי כְּשֵׁירֵי</he> in what sense is <he>צנועי</he> here used? In the sense of K’sheré (the worthies of the house of Hillel).

<cite ref="Yoma 19b:14">Yoma 19ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01812"><he>חָשַׁד</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:6">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> top <he>שאין כשירין</he>, read: <cite ref="M01442"><he>מַכְשִׁירִין</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K01324"><he>כָּשֵׁר</he> I</cite>.]

senses.gloss: apt, convenient. Mekh. Bo, s. 16; Tanḥ. Bo 11 חדש שהוא כ׳ וכ׳ a month convenient to you, when it is not too warm &c.
